title: Field Notes 01: the 2,400-year-old personality test
caption:
Before personality quizzes, there were the four temperaments.

Hippocrates described four humours. Galen turned them into temperaments. Ibn Sina set them out in the Canon of Medicine, taught from Central Asia to Europe for centuries. Unani tradition still uses them today, and Mizaj pairs them with modern type psychology.

History and traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.

Save this, and send it to the friend who thinks personality tests are a new fad.
